skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK damage to the entire enemy row.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK damage to the entire enemy row.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally acts, has a 20% chance to launch a follow-up with basic-attack damage against the enemy with the lowest HP (up to 2 follow-ups per turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally acts, has a 20% chance to launch a follow-up dealing 100% of Basic Attack damage against the enemy with the lowest HP (up to 2 follow-ups per turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. After an ally acts, has a 20% chance to launch a follow-up dealing 110% of Basic Attack damage against the enemy with the lowest HP (up to 2 follow-ups per turn).
